description: Delete a Gmail label. Takes the label ID (from gmail_list_labels), not the label name. This removes the label from every message that carries it; the messages themselves are not deleted. System labels (INBOX, UNREAD, SENT) cannot be deleted.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

label_id.description: The label ID to delete (from gmail_list_labels)

name: gws-mcp__gmail_delete_label
